component.name: Mail
component.summary: Manage local mail, drafts, rules and attachments
Lokale E-Mails, Entwürfe, Regeln und Anhänge verwalten
إدارة البريد المحلي والمسودات والقواعد والمرفقات

description.p: Mail provides a desktop workspace for locally stored messages, drafts, account configuration, rules, signatures and attachment payloads.
Configured accounts synchronize mail over TLS-protected IMAP and submit outgoing messages over TLS-protected SMTP. Drafts and queued messages remain available locally while offline.
Use standard IMAP mailbox roles, move emptied Junk to Trash, and improve parsing of mail with legacy encodings.
